tagline: Cloud browser sessions for remote teammates — page actions need your approval.
requirements: Set BROWSERBASE_API_KEY and BROWSERBASE_PROJECT_ID in the host environment. This is the official server from Browserbase; sessions run in your project and meter to your plan. Playwright-driven reading and acting on live web pages.

tools.name: navigate
tools.note: Opens a URL in the session.

tools.name: observe
tools.note: Lists actionable elements on the current page.

tools.name: extract
tools.note: Reads structured content from the current page.

tools.name: act
tools.note: Clicks, types, and submits on live pages — a prompt-injected page can steer it, so review each action.

seo.description: Share the official Browserbase MCP server with MCPWire. Configure the API key on the host, let teammates read pages in a cloud browser over P2P, and keep page actions behind approval.
